_meta.description: The SAFE, auto-rewritable subset of removed-functions.json: global functions removed at a major whose replacement is an exact 1:1 global-function rename with a compatible call signature for the dominant call shape. Consumed by the data-driven AST rules ElggMigrate\Rules\V5ToV6\RemovedFunctions and V6ToV7\RemovedFunctions (via Rules\Shared\DataDrivenRemovedFunctions), which rewrite FuncCall names in place. Entries whose replacement is prose, needs new arguments, changes semantics, or is a method/service call (e.g. ELGG's AMD->ESM migration, elgg_set_ignore_access -> elgg_call(...), elgg_reset_system_cache -> _elgg_services()->systemCache->clear()) are DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED here — they stay LLM-guided in the manifest because a blind rename would corrupt code.
_meta.relationship: This is a strict subset of references/removed-functions.json (which drives DETECTION/flagging in PostMigrationVerifier + VersionGuard --check, cumulatively). This file drives REWRITING and is per-major.
_meta.signature_note: For multi-arg helpers included here (forward, register_error, system_message), the rename is correct for the dominant single-message/single-url call; the manifest's LLM instructions still cover the rarer multi-arg reason/priority cases.
